data.text:
The real estate market in Dubai has always been synonymous with innovation and luxury, setting trends that shape the future of urban living. Now Laguna Residence Dubai takes this legacy to a new level, introducing the region’s first fully AI-powered residential development. Nestled in the dynamic City of Arabia, this flagship project by ONE Development promises to revolutionize real estate by blending technology, sustainability, and premium living in unprecedented ways. And we’ve got an inside scoop for this upcoming project for you right here!

ONE Development Unveils Laguna Residence at a Spectacular Event

Laguna Residence was officially announced during a spectacular event at Dubai’s Coca-Cola Arena. The launch ceremony featured dazzling performances and appearances by global icons, including music sensation Amr Diab, Bollywood star Kareena Kapoor, and renowned Egyptian actor Amir Karara. The event was hosted by international presenter Raya Abi-Rached and Egyptian star Sherif Mounir.

At the official unveiling of Laguna Residence, held against the stunning backdrop of the City of Arabia, Dubailand, ONE Development’s Founder & Chairman, Ali Al Gebely, highlighted the company’s unwavering commitment to Dubai’s progress and the region’s ever-evolving real estate sector. Speaking passionately about its flagship AED 2 billion project, he said:

“As a homegrown boutique developer, our mission is to reflect the unique aspirations and lifestyles of our clientele in the UAE. By delivering iconic, high-quality developments, we align with the UAE’s strategic ambitions and leadership’s vision to attract local, regional, and international investors, setting a new benchmark in the real estate industry.”

Laguna Residence, City of Arabia - An Overview

Laguna Residence, the UAE’s first AI-integrated residential project, has quickly become one of the most sought-after and talked-about developments in Dubai. Designed by AE7, Laguna Residence will offer more than just stylish architecture.

The two high-rise towers will be connected by a grand podium lagoon, the largest of its kind, creating a unique waterfront experience right in the heart of the city. Offering studios, three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, and sky-homes, this project is all set to combine luxury with cutting-edge technology, raising the bar for urban living.

With over 40 state-of-the-art amenities ranging from wellness spaces to entertainment hubs, the development in Dubailand aims to meet the needs of residents seeking an all-inclusive lifestyle. Here’s everything you need to know about Dubai’s newest project.

Laguna Residence: Pioneering AI-Integrated Living 

Laguna Residence seamlessly integrates smart technology with eco-conscious design, offering residents a truly modern yet sustainable living experience. The AI-integrated property will anticipate residents' needs, whether it’s adjusting home temperatures based on preferences or ensuring smooth logistics for everyday tasks through automated systems. Ali Al Gebely remarked in the launch event:

“Laguna Residence is a unique project, introducing the UAE’s first AI-integrated residential community. It offers a sophisticated lifestyle, combining convenience with personalized services. Our goal is to redefine the real estate industry by elevating daily life and reshaping the meaning of quality living. This community not only embraces technology, innovation, and sustainability but also champions eco-friendly solutions.”

Why Investors are Eyeing AI-Powered Real Estate in Dubai

AI-integrated smart homes are becoming more than just a trend—they are the future. These homes will leverage artificial intelligence for personalized experiences, automating energy management, security, and home maintenance. 

AI-powered systems adapt to residents' preferences, creating seamless and efficient living environments. As Dubai continues to embrace smart technology, these developments are poised to redefine convenience, sustainability, and luxury, setting a new standard for modern communities.

As part of the UAE’s efforts to promote digital transformation, Laguna Residence sets a new benchmark for Dubai AI residences. The project’s focus on innovation and sustainability aligns with the government’s vision to enhance transparency, streamline transactions, and attract high-net-worth investors from around the world.

data.answer: AI-powered systems provide real-time surveillance, facial recognition, and automated access control for enhanced safety and convenience.

faqs.question: Can residents customize the AI features in their homes?

data.answer: Yes, the AI system allows residents to personalize settings for lighting, temperature, and entertainment to suit their preferences.

faqs.question: What sustainable features are integrated into Laguna Residence?

data.answer: AI optimizes energy use, monitors water consumption, and supports waste management, promoting eco-friendly living.

faqs.question: How will AI impact property management services in Laguna Residence?

data.answer: The AI platform automates maintenance schedules, service requests, and predictive repairs, reducing downtime for residents.

faqs.question: What kind of entertainment options does the AI system offer?

data.answer: Residents can enjoy AI-curated content for home theaters, smart TVs, and music systems, customized to their tastes and routines.
